## Half state healed — this card carried `pm:blocked` with no `Blocked-by:` line and no surviving rationale. Rolled back to `pm:queue`, evidence below.

`domain:spec` execution PM seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-15T01:17Z.

### What the state machine requires, and what this card had

`pm:blocked` is only half a state. The other half is a machine-greppable `Blocked-by: #N` line in the body, because that line is the reverse index three separate duties read: returning the card when the upstream closes, ordering by unlock fan-out, and re-verifying its file surface against the merged ref. A `pm:blocked` with no line is inert — nothing will ever return it.

This card had no line. I went looking for the reason anyway:

| where a reason could live | measured |
|---|---|
| body `Blocked-by:` line | ⛔ none — `grep -E '^Blocked-by:'` over the full 3,947-byte body: 0 hits |
| body prose | ⛔ names no upstream. It ends "Filed unassigned and unlabelled by the dev seat on #17328, for triage." |
| the two comments the API counts | ⛔ **unreadable — they are gone.** `GET /issues/17670/comments?per_page=100` returns `[]` while the issue payload's `comments` field reads `2` |
| the timeline | ⛔ returns 5 events, all `cross-referenced`. **Zero `labeled` events**, though the card carries four labels |

**Both zero readings are controlled, so neither is an instrument failure.** Same REST call, same session, same minute: `GET /issues/18122/comments?per_page=100` → 1 comment. Same timeline call on #18231 and #17502 → full `labeled`/`unlabeled` histories. And a **second instrument** agrees on the subject: MCP `issue_read method=get_comments` on this card also returns `[]`. Two instruments, one lit control each ⇒ the comments were deleted and the `comments: 2` counter is stale.

⇒ There is no record of who set `pm:blocked`, when, or on what. 「等待他座位也是状态,写在卡上才存在」 — a block that is not written on the card does not exist. I cannot complete the pair, so I roll back the half that has no support. That is the rule's own second branch: 半状态…补齐成对或回滚半边.

### Before returning it to the queue I re-measured every premise it rests on

⛔ Not from the card's text — from `origin/main` @ `8c657f7dd0`, 2026-09-15T01:16Z. The card's line numbers have drifted; the sentences have not.

| carrier | card said | measured now | still live? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` `colSpan.describe()` | `:2489` | `:2569`, "a fixed span only lines up at the width the author imagined" | ✅ |
| 2 same file, `span.describe()` | `:2494` | `:2574`, "'full': whole row at any column count" | ✅ |
| 3 `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` (generated from 1) | 2 rows | 2 hits | ✅ |
| 4 `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` | `:412`, `:428` | `:434`, `:450` | ✅ |
| 5 `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` | `:223` | `:223` | ✅ |
| 6 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` | `:136`, `:139` | `:139` | ✅ |

And the upstream it actually cites: **#17328 is `closed` / `completed`.** So the measurement this card depends on is landed, not pending — which is the opposite of a blocked premise. Nothing here has been done; all six carriers of the two false sentences are on the tree today.

### Two fences for whoever dispatches this, so they are not discovered mid-round

1. **Carrier 6 is a governed surface.** `skills/**` is human-merge only and belongs to `domain:skills`, not this lane. A single `domain:spec` round cannot land it. Either the card splits — five carriers here, carrier 6 as a `domain:skills` card with `Blocked-by:` this one — or the round lands five and files the sixth. That decision belongs to whoever picks it up; I am not making it from here, and I am not re-routing a card I have not claimed.
2. **Carrier 3 is generated, never hand-edited.** It moves when carrier 1 moves, which pulls `gen:schema` / `gen:docs` and the generated-artifact gate family into the diff — the reason the card was split off #17328 in the first place.
3. **`Clause-②: yes` when it is claimed.** Carriers 1 and 2 are `.describe()` prose in `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts`, and that glob is listed literally in `packages/spec`'s `package.json` `files[]` — the sentences ship to npm verbatim. Rewriting published prose is exactly what the contract-review gate is for.

⛔ I am **not** claiming this card; it goes back to the queue unassigned, graded and routed as it already was. Only the unsupported `pm:blocked` half is withdrawn.

## 前一轮留下的两道围栏,照抄以免重新发现

- **载体 3 是生成物** —— 动载体 1 就会拉进 `gen:schema` / `gen:docs` 与生成物门禁族。⚠️ 本班在 PR #18403 上栽过两次:只改源、生成物还带旧文本,被 `check:docs` 逮住。**两面都要数,四个计数全报。**
- 本卡曾是 `pm:blocked` 却无 `Blocked-by:` 行、且两条评论已被删除,本席 2026-09-15T01:17Z 以双控制读数回滚为 `pm:queue`。⇒ 它没有在案的上游,⛔ 不要去找。

`Clause-②: yes`:载体 1、2 是 `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 的 `.describe()`,而 `src/**/*.zod.ts` 在该包 `files[]` 里 —— 改的是**已发布包对自己行为的陈述**,拿不准按 yes。

### ⭐ The finding, and why it is worth the round

The round did the right work: it re-verified all five carriers on `origin/main` before editing, caught a sixth carrier the card's table missed (the TSDoc above `FormField.span`), and took option **A** on the prescription question — which the review independently confirms is right, with evidence the round did not have (no `.deprecated()`, no `retiredKey`, no `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE` row, no ADR-0087 entry for `colSpan`; lit control `retiredKey` = 931 lines).

| probe (3-column grid) | at the pin `53ded82bf7` | at objectui `main` `ff1d5ea8` |

| `colSpan: 4` | `@2xl:col-span-3` | `@md:col-span-2 @2xl:col-span-3` |

⭐ **And this is the part that makes it more than a staleness bug**: objectui#9244's own docblock, its two tests and its changeset quote the sentence this PR **deletes** — 「whole row at any column count」 — as *the published declaration they implement*. ⇒ the PR would rewrite the contract to codify the behaviour the implementer had just fixed **against** that contract, three days earlier. ⛔ Neither the card, the round, nor this seat saw that; the isolated review did, by running the code at two commits.

Also corrected: the span is the **form grid's** column count (explicit form `columns` ?? widest section's `columns` ?? inferred, `ObjectForm.tsx:1359-1361`), ⛔ not 「the section's declared column count」 — they coincide only in a single-section form, which is exactly what #17328 measured.

### The ten owed changes

Verbatim in the record's 「Required changes for PASS」 (R1–R10), with **exact replacement strings** for each carrier. The shape of the fix: say what the key resolves to (the form grid's full column count — true on both states), then anchor the **tier** behaviour to a named commit rather than asserting it timelessly. R10 (a line-initial `Clause-②: yes` on the PR body) is recommended, ⛔ not blocking.
